description:
PROBLEM TYPE: MIP

PROBLEM INFO:

- A division of an auto parts manufacturer produces \var{P} different parts using \var{M} different machines.
- Batch of 100 part \var{p} requires \var{time_{m,p}} hours on machine \var{m}.
- The division incurs a charge of \var{cost_{m}} per hour for using machine \var{m}.
- Machine \var{m} has an availability of up to \var{available_{m}} hours per month.
- The division sells part \var{p} in batches of 100 at price of \var{price_{p}} per batch.
- Machine \var{1} requires a setup time of \var{setup_time_{p}} hours before it can be used for each part \var{p}.
- Other machines do not require a setup time.
- There are no minimum production quantities for any part.

INPUT FORMAT: 

{
    "time_required": [[time_{m,p} for p in 1, ..., P] for m in 1, ..., M],
    "machine_costs": [cost_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "availability": [available_{m} for m in 1, ..., M],
    "prices": [price_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "setup_time": [setup_time_{p} for p in 1, ..., P]
}

OBJECTIVE: How many batches of each part should the manufacturer produce each month to maximize profit?

OUTPUT INFO:

- the number of batches of each part produced \var{batches_{p}}.
- \var{setup_flags_{p}} indicates whether \var{part_{p}} is set up or not.
- \var{total_profit} represents the total profit obtained for the month.

OUTPUT FORMAT:

{
    "batches": [batches_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "setup_flags": [setup_flag_{p} for p in 1, ..., P],
    "total_profit": total_profit
}

P.definition: The number of types of parts to produce

TimeRequired.definition: The time required to produce a batch on machine m for part p

MachineCosts.definition: The cost of operating machine m for a month

Availability.definition: The time each machine m is available for production each month

Prices.definition: The price at which part p can be sold

SetupTime.definition: The setup time required before producing a batch of part p

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total monthly profit from producing and selling batches of parts, calculated as total sales revenue minus machine operating and setup costs."
objective.formulation: $\max \left( \sum_{p=1}^{P} Prices_{p}\, batches_{p} \;-\; \sum_{m=1}^{M} \sum_{p=1}^{P} MachineCosts_{m}\, TimeRequired_{m,p}\, batches_{p} \;-\; \sum_{p=1}^{P} MachineCosts_{1}\, SetupTime_{p}\, setupFlags_{p} \right)$

constraints.description: For each machine m ≠ 1, the total processing time used by all batches on machine m cannot exceed its availability: sum over p of (TimeRequired[m,p] * batches_p) ≤ Availability[m]
For machine 1, the total processing time including setup times cannot exceed its availability: sum over p of (TimeRequired[1,p] * batches_p + SetupTime[p] * setup_flag_p) ≤ Availability[1]
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(TimeRequired[0][p] * batches[p] + SetupTime[p] * setupFlags[p] for p in range(P))
    <= Availability[0]
)

constraints.description: For each part p, batches_p must be a non-negative integer
For each part p, setup_flag_p is a binary variable (0 or 1)
For each part p, batches_p can only be positive if setup_flag_p = 1 (linking constraint between batches_p and setup_flag_p)
constraints.code:
for p in range(P):
    model.addConstr(batches[p] <= M * setupFlags[p])

batches.definition: The number of batches of part p produced per month

setupFlags.definition: Binary variable equal to 1 if machine 1 is set up for part p, and 0 otherwise
